## 🌐 TSPANN Registry Integration Request

Thank you for contributing to the Subdomain Project for Assigned Names and Numbers! Please complete the checklist and provide the required information below to add your authoritative subdomain registry to the global TSPANN network.

### 📋 Integration Checklist
- [ ] I have read the project privacy policy and understand that all data published to the repository will be completely public.
- [ ] My target domain suffix is active and currently available for developers or community use.
- [ ] My server outputs structured JSON conforming to the core protocol definitions (RFC 9083).
- [ ] I have tested my registry endpoints, and they return valid HTTP responses.

---

### 🔧 Suffix & Server Details

Please provide the structural endpoints you want added to the core `bootstrap.json` index:

* **Subdomain Suffix Managed:** (e.g., `is-a.dev`, `is-an.app`)
* **Authoritative RDAP Base URL:** (e.g., `https://<username>.github.io/domain/`)
* **Primary Technical Contact Name/Handle:** 

---

### 🧪 Sample Entry Verification

To assist our maintainers during code review, please share the live URL to a working sample domain mapped inside your registry payload:

* **Live Sample URL:** `https://<username>.github.io/domain/sample.suffix.json`

### 📝 Additional Context or Scope
*(Optional: Add any details regarding the scope of your community project, volume of subdomains handled, or custom extensions supported.)*
